basics.name: Sina Mohammadi
basics.label: Ph.D. Candidate in Electrical & Computer Engineering
basics.summary: Ph.D. candidate at University of Michigan-Dearborn specializing in power systems engineering, AC Optimal Power Flow (ACOPF), physics-informed neural networks, and distribution network state estimation.

courses: Dissertation: Machine Learning Applications for Optimizing Power Systems Operation
Thesis: An Optimal Strategy for Protection of Inverter-Interfaced Microgrids in Different Working Modes
Supervisors: Mansour Ojaghi, Ph.D., Abolfazl Jalilvand, Ph.D.
Thesis: Analysis, Modeling and Comparison of Different Types of Power Converters in Switched Reluctance Motor

work.name: University of Michigan-Dearborn
highlights: Working on topology estimation of low-voltage distribution networks using smart meter data.
Proposed novel methods for topology recovery including hierarchical clustering of incremental voltage measurements.
Investigating label-free physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for solving Optimal Power Flow (OPF).

work.name: University of Zanjan
highlights: Proposed a novel pilot-based unit protection method for meshed microgrids using apparent resistance estimation.
